pr.title: Record the installer checks that v0.2.0 answered
pr.head: 705b695110d90eaf78ba0d4aafe0e3ef0eb2a04c

summary: multipass installs from a GitHub release: install.sh builds the tagged source when Rust is installed, and otherwise installs the release's prebuilt binary only after gh attestation verify proves the release workflow built it. multipass upgrade runs the newest installer for you. The installer plan, docs/projects/installer/readme.md, is finished (status: completed), and its § 9 Outcome lists each acceptance check with the evidence for it.

Two of those checks could not run until a second release existed: a release started by merging a pull request that raises the version (the first release, v0.1.0, was started by a workflow dispatch), and multipass upgrade from one release behind. The merge of #46 published v0.2.0, so this pull request records what those checks showed. It edits only § 9 and changes no status or decision.

The first head put the new group in the middle of the "Not run" list, so three checks that never ran read as verified with v0.2.0. The second commit moved the group to the end of § 9, and the review's finding on it is resolved.

cards.title: What public evidence confirms
cards.html:
• The v0.2.0 release is immutable, carries the five assets, and its tag names 4299aa2.
  • Release run 46049576523 ran on the push of 4299aa2 to main and succeeded.
  • The binary's attestation passes for refs/heads/main at 4299aa2, with no login.
  • SHA256SUMS matches the downloaded binary and install.sh.
  • getmultipass.dev/install.sh and /v0.2.0/install.sh redirect to the right release files.

cards.title: What only the owner's runs show
cards.html:
• The upgrade --check and upgrade runs from 0.1.0, and their output.
  • The first attempt that met a 504 and exited 69, leaving 0.1.0 installed.
  • The one-line install through getmultipass.dev installing 0.2.0.

The quoted messages and exit codes match the code at v0.1.0 and the installer's output rows.

groups.title: The plan's outcome
groups.kicker: § 9 records the results of the two checks that waited for v0.2.0
intro: § 9 of the plan sorts every acceptance check into groups by how it was shown: verified against v0.1.0 and the live domain, verified by the tests CI runs, and not run. The first item under "Not run" said that the merge-started release and the upgrade from one release behind needed a second release. This change rewords that item to say both have since passed, and appends a fourth group after the "Not run" list, "Verified with v0.2.0, after this plan merged", with one item per result. The other three "Not run" items stay where they were.

A completed plan is a record of what was decided and built, so it keeps its decisions as they were. Its outcome may still take the result of a check it deferred, once the check runs, and that is all this change adds.

files.note: The installer plan; only § 9 Outcome changes.

checks.text: Checked from public evidence: gh release view v0.2.0 reports an immutable release with the five assets, the tag names 4299aa2, run 46049576523 is the Release workflow on that push and succeeded, and gh attestation verify on the downloaded binary passes with --source-ref refs/heads/main and --source-digest at 4299aa2, and fails with refs/tags/v0.2.0.

These runs happened on the owner's machine, so no public record shows them. The messages, exit codes, and output rows quoted here match src/upgrade.rs at v0.1.0 and install.sh, and rustc 1.97.1 is the toolchain the release's build info names.
